method: The 59 OSM monument / artwork objects left out in round 2 (r2/world gen-monuments) re-read from live OSM tags (api 0.6, 2026-11-13); free-standing candidates (tourism=artwork without artwork_type) looked at in official panoramas where one is within 50 m. Drawn ones are listed at the end of game/src/monument-sources.js.
footprintSkips: Unchanged (reported, never moved): Mihail Cantacuzino n916016099 and Domnița Bălașa n921821381 fall inside a building footprint; Dimitar Hadjvasilev n6945692385 and Bustul lui Barbu Constantinescu n10726686133 on a carriageway; Root n11862631648 and Story Pole VI n12554043199 (Bellevue). Positions are OSM's; not checked against panoramas this round.

subjectForms: Since 2026-11-13 (monuments.js MONUMENT_SUBJECT) five works whose subject their OSM name and article give have a low-poly subject form instead of the class block, still not likenesses: the equestrian Carol I n1883108499 (OSM height 13 m), Lupoaica n1731041124 (she-wolf with the twins on a tall pedestal), Leul w170953582 and Leul Ierusalimului n7350336938 (a standing lion), Memorialul Renașterii n1393030628 (a white spire through a dark crown, about 25 m after ro.wikipedia; OSM has no height; skipped while its node lies inside a mapped building outline). Proportions are estimates; no panorama was traced.
